messages.text:
"Create a simple 2D side-scrolling action game.

Main Character:
- Female swordswoman
- Uses a one-handed sword
- Fast attacks
- Can run, jump, double jump, and wall jump
- Can perform a dash

Gameplay:
- Side-scrolling platformer
- Defeat monsters with sword attacks
- Collect coins and health items
- Simple combo system (3-hit combo)

Enemies:
- Slime
- Goblin
- Flying bat

Level:
- Forest stage
- Platforms and cliffs
- Hidden treasure chest

Boss:
- Giant armored knight
- Sword attacks and charge attack

Art Style:
- Anime-inspired
- Colorful fantasy world

Keep the project simple and playable.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
